pageProps.content: ## Review Visited because it's renowned as one of Melbourne's top 3 coffees. As expected, there was quite a queue given its popularity. I thought the crowd would mean a long wait, but the line moved faster than expected and I was able to order in no time. When I ordered a Long Black and asked for a medium size, the staff kindly let me know that's called a `Long Long Black`. They ask for your name when you order, then call it out when your coffee is ready outside. While waiting, they also handed out a glass of water each. ```adcard ``` Being a weekday, most people seemed to be office workers grabbing takeout on their way to work. I'm not sure it was noticeably better than other places, but as always, Australian coffee delivered wherever I went. ## Pictures
